## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Kolaṁkolakathā* is a debate located in the twelfth chapter of the *Kathāvatthu* (Kv 12.6) in the Abhidhamma Piṭaka [Catalog]. The controversy examined in the text concerns whether an individual passing from family to family (*kolaṁkola*, a specific grade of stream-enterer) is fixed or assured (*niyata*) to that precise destiny [Bareau 1955].
